payloads.payload/buffer.txt: A bounded buffer keeps bytes in order. A byte buffer has a capacity.
payloads.payload/queue.txt: Antrean berurutan menjaga data. Baca data, periksa ukuran, lalu simpan data.
payloads.payload/shell.txt:
Use synthetic paths for examples.
printf '%s\n' 'hello  buffer'
ls ./examples
payloads.payload/unicode.txt: UTF-8 preserves café, é, Δ, 日本語, and 🔍 as exact bytes.
payloads.payload/protocol.txt: TCP carries a byte stream. UDP carries datagrams. DNS names records.
payloads.payload/mode.txt: Inspect a synthetic directory with stat ./examples and pwd.
payloads.payload/paths.txt: The local fixture path is ./examples/buffer.txt. The file ends with LF.
payloads.payload/length.txt: Panjang data dihitung dalam byte. Ukuran buffer dicatat sebelum pembacaan.
payloads.payload/hex.txt: A mask of 0x0f is the same integer as 0b00001111.
payloads.payload/newline.txt: One tab:	here. Two spaces:  here. Literal marker: <|eos|>.
payloads.payload/buffer-copy.txt: A bounded buffer keeps bytes in order. A byte buffer has a capacity.
